how: Marked by hand from colour contact sheets at every 10th frame (lane lidar, Sat 14 Nov 20:20). index is the packet index in the file (0 to 420); frame_id = index + 29359 on this clip. The person faces the phone wearing both Smartgloves in every frame, so there is no hand-free span and false accepts cannot be measured on this clip.
